sourceProvenance: Declared by clean update-source metadata; captured running ELF matched the candidate.
limits: Stitched exclusive USB sessions with handoff gaps; not an uninterrupted serial trace.
Each raw channel is screened for faults/identity changes and validated in capture order before merge.
High-water marks are fill-pattern observations including instrumentation, not a worst-case bound.
Deferred SDK record uptime is reporting time; exact callback time is not exported.
Scan timing excludes UART/logging time; task minima persist across workload phases.

LCD updater fields are sampled cumulative extrema, not phase-local allocation bounds. Zero minimum/peak fields mean unsampled; tlsFailures zero means no failure reported in sampled cumulative records.
Only 12 selected tasks are tracked; rolesUnobserved is relative to that allowlist, not a full firmware inventory. Wi-Fi-driver, IPC and ISR stacks were not measured.
No motion, pairing, limits or generic-board qualification is implied.
Manual menu Wi-Fi scan is a separate post-recovery interval; scan visibility is a user report, not an automated visual assertion.

The scheduled two-hour recovery includes user-reported menu navigation; strict uninterrupted idle is unqualified. Action selection and navigation duration are user reports only; unknown duration remains unknown, and no earlier quiet period is assumed.
